sql: SELECT 'logs' AS src, function_name AS fn, model, count(*) AS calls, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, round(sum(estimated_cost_usd)::numeric, 4) AS usd, min(created_at)::date AS de, max(created_at)::date AS ate FROM ai_usage_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'agent', kind || CASE WHEN is_test THEN ' (teste)' ELSE '' END, model, count(*), sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), round(sum(cost_usd)::numeric, 4), min(created_at)::date, max(created_at)::date FROM ai_agent_usage WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 6 DESC
